definitions.explanation: Refers to many places throughout a given area or context. Often used in the pattern {随所|ずいしょ}に to mean 'in various places' or 'throughout.' Carries a somewhat literary or formal tone compared to everyday words like あちこち.

examples.japanese: {随所|ずいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Clever touches can be seen throughout.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じさせる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{随所|ずいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are things that evoke history everywhere in this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ユーモア→ユーモア：00432_yuumoa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{随所|ずいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ちりばめられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: His work is peppered with his unique humor throughout.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as {随所|ずいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Has a written or formal feel; in casual conversation, ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧ or いたる⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧ would be more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {随所|ずいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧ (can be seen throughout)
- {随所|ずいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ちりばめる (to scatter throughout)
- {随所|ずいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there are clever touches throughout)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {随所|ずいしょ}: everywhere (literary/formal tone)
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧: here and there (casual, conversational)
- いたる⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧: everywhere (slightly formal, emphasizes completeness)
- ⟦{各所|かくしょ}→各所：16088_kakusho⟧: various places (neutral, often administrative)
